course.title: Photoshop: From First Win to Finished Work
course.subtitle: A project-driven, spiral path through Adobe Photoshop
course.description: Learn Photoshop the way professionals actually work — one finished deliverable at a time. Every stage produces something real, skills are taught exactly when you need them, and the core ideas (non-destructive editing, the layer stack, masks as grayscale, and selections) come back at greater depth as you grow.

author.name: Ray de la Paz
author.bio: Technical trainer, full-stack developer, and course developer with 30+ years of experience.

structure.note: A linear learning PATH (Stages 0-7), each producing a finished deliverable, runs alongside a parallel RECIPES library of always-open standalone how-tos. Core ideas are re-taught at increasing depth.

modules.title: Stage 0 — Your First Win
modules.deliverable: One photo, fixed and exported, in about 20 minutes.
modules.description: The non-destructive loop end to end: open, crop, one adjustment layer, export. Prove to yourself that you can do this.

modules.title: Stage 1 — Foundations
modules.description: The layer stack for real, masks as grayscale, and your first proper selections.

lessons.title: The Layer Stack & Your First Mask

modules.title: Stage 2 — Light & Color
modules.deliverable: A flat photo graded and alive.
modules.description: Camera Raw, Curves, adjustment layers, and Smart Objects.

modules.title: Stage 3 — Retouching
modules.description: Healing and clone, content-aware, and frequency separation.

modules.title: Stage 4 — Compositing
modules.description: Select Subject / Select & Mask, blend modes, and matching light.

modules.title: Stage 5 — Design & Type
modules.description: Pen and shapes, type on a path, layer styles, Smart Objects.

modules.title: Stage 6 — AI & Speed
modules.deliverable: A generative edit plus an automated batch.
modules.description: Generative Fill / Expand, Actions, Image Processor, and droplets.

modules.title: Stage 7 — Capstone
modules.description: You choose the brief; you defend the decisions.

modules.title: ↔ Recipes
modules.description: "How do I remove a background?" "How do I straighten a horizon?" Short, self-contained answers you can jump to any time.

visualsPolicy.note: No live Photoshop hookup — real PS UI screenshots cannot be captured in-session. Visuals are (1) theme-aware Mermaid diagrams, (2) hand-built SVG panel/dialog mockups (clearly not passed off as real screenshots), and (3) real before/after example images. Before/after art in this prototype uses labeled SVG stand-ins; real photos drop into the same .ba-slider slots. Real PS UI captures must come from Ray or licensed sources.
